newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures cut losses, still lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures cut losses, still lower.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. stock index futures cut their losses as traders chewed through headlines from the Beige Book. Traders said the report gave a sense of subdued inflation worries. In June S&Ps, one dealer's sales now up to 1,500, a trader said. Short-covering seen on the pop up from the lows, he said.
